color_palette_roles.philosophy: Strict 5-role appetite palette balancing cream dairy silk, rich cacao depth, and vibrant cherry acidity.

role_1_canvas_cream.name: Chantilly Cream / Unbleached Parchment
role_1_canvas_cream.usage: Primary page background, high-breathability negative space, warm light canvas that avoids sterile digital pure white (#FFFFFF).

role_2_ganache_noir.name: 70% Valrhona Ganache / Espresso Noir
role_2_ganache_noir.usage: Primary headline typography, solid anchor surfaces, high-contrast footer, and sharp structural frames. Never use pure black (#000000).

role_3_morello_cherry.name: Ripe Morello Cherry Red
role_3_morello_cherry.usage: Primary kinetic triggers, WhatsApp CTA buttons, highlight tags, notification badges, and focal appetite accents.

role_4_toasted_praline.name: Toasted Almond Praline
role_4_toasted_praline.usage: 1px structural grid lines, subtle divider borders, badge outlines, and gentle background cards.

role_5_bourbon_caramel.name: Salted Butter Caramel / Bourbon Gold
role_5_bourbon_caramel.usage: Tasting notes, star ratings, chef selection badges, award stamps, and pricing highlights.

rules: BANNED: Never use Inter, Roboto, or Arial for headings.
Never exceed text-6xl for hero titles to prevent visual blowout.
Pair bold serif titles with generous line-height on body text (leading-relaxed).
Use tabular figures for pricing and weights to maintain vertical alignment.

desktop_1440px.grid_strategy: Tetris Grid (Mode A) with 12-column Swiss architecture, intentional asymmetric offsets, 1px praline dividing borders, and negative breathing space.
desktop_1440px.hero_layout: Asymmetric 7:5 split. Left: Editorial stacked headline with line-reveal stagger, live atelier status pill, and dual action CTAs. Right: Dominant hero cake frame with floating chef badge and seasonal ingredients overlay.
desktop_1440px.menu_layout: 3-column staggered bento grid with featured hero cake occupying 2 columns and 2 rows.
desktop_1440px.manifesto_layout: 4-column horizontal chapter spread with numbered chapter markers (01-04) and continuous top praline border.

mobile_390px.grid_strategy: Single column stacked editorial narrative, maintaining vertical rhythm with 48px to 64px section gaps.
mobile_390px.touch_targets: Minimum 48px height with full-width primary CTA buttons.

sections_architecture.heading: The Bakehouse Principles
sections_architecture.subheading: Four non-negotiable standards that distinguish artisanal pastry from commercial confectionery.

chapters.title: The 48-Hour Cold Ferment
chapters.description: Our sourdough sponge and brioche sponges undergo extended slow fermentation at 4°C. This allows wild microflora to unlock deep nutty aromatics and tender gluten structure without synthetic improvers.

chapters.title: Karnataka Terroir & Single-Origin Cacao
chapters.description: We source cacao pods directly from agro-forest estates in Coorg and Western Ghats, roasted at low temperatures to retain natural fruity acidity, red berry notes, and earthy wood tannins.

chapters.title: Wild Botanicals & Nilgiri Cherries
chapters.description: No artificial syrups or canned glazes. Our preserves are simmered from organic Morello cherries and sour cherries cultivated in the Ooty highlands, infused with wild vanilla from Wayanad.

chapters.title: Architectural Pastry Design
chapters.description: Each tier is engineered with precision geometry, structural chocolate ganache pillars, and hand-tempered feather shards. Visual tension meets delicate, melt-in-mouth mouthfeel.

motion_and_interactions_pure_css.philosophy: Zero framer-motion dependency. High-performance, butter-smooth native CSS keyframes and vanilla JS IntersectionObserver triggers.

keyframes.line_reveal: @keyframes lineReveal { from { transform: translateY(100%); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; } }
keyframes.subtle_pulse_glow: @keyframes softGlow { 0%, 100% { opacity: 0.3; transform: scale(1); } 50% { opacity: 0.6; transform: scale(1.05); } }

micro_interactions: Image Card Hover: scale-105 transition-transform duration-500 ease-out + subtle inner chocolate shadow.
CTA Button Hover: -translate-y-0.5 shadow-md shadow-[#A61C2E]/25 transition-all duration-200 active:translate-y-0.
Scroll Intersection: Observer adds 'is-visible' class removing translate-y-6 and opacity-0.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Read this entire JSON guideline file (/app/design_guidelines.json) before generating frontend code in /app/frontend.

2. Strict Palette Enforcement: Use the 5 primary roles (#FAF5EE cream canvas, #1E130D ganache noir text/anchors, #A61C2E cherry red kinetic CTAs, #D9C5B2 praline borders, #D49B55 caramel accents). Never revert to default SaaS blue (#3B82F6), generic cool slate, or pure black (#000000).
3. Typography: Load Playfair Display / Bodoni Moda for all headers/titles and Outfit / Cabinet Grotesk for body and buttons. Strictly observe H1 ceiling at text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl.
4. WhatsApp Ordering Flow: Ensure all WhatsApp buttons have data-testid attributes and dynamic link generation pointing to https://wa.me/918049520000 with pre-filled cake details.
5. Motion Rule: Implement smooth CSS keyframe animations and IntersectionObserver reveals without installing heavy framer-motion dependencies.
6. Hero Image Overlay Rule: Never place heavy dark overlays over the hero cake photo. Use clean contrast framing, delicate drop shadows, and soft ambient warmth.
7. Testing: Ensure all data-testid attributes listed in testing_attributes_registry are attached directly to their respective HTML/React elements.

design_anti_patterns_to_avoid: No generic centered templates or cookie-cutter SaaS layouts.
No AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) used as functional icons. Use clean Lucide SVG icons (Phone, MessageCircle, Clock, MapPin, Sparkles, Star, ShieldCheck, ChevronRight).
No flat unstyled inputs. Inputs in the WhatsApp order calculator must have warm parchment backgrounds, 1px praline borders, and cherry focus rings.
No full-screen gradients. Texture, clean negative space, and fine 1px border lines create true editorial luxury.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.responsiveness: Ensure flawless responsiveness from 390px (mobile viewport with sticky bottom WhatsApp action bar) to 1440px+ (desktop 12-col Swiss Tetris grid).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_policy: All interactive buttons, dropdowns, inputs, cake cards, and location badges must strictly include specified kebab-case data-testid tags.
